from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
# Try a highly constrained grayscale and CMYK pair to see if decoder behavior differs; keep one candidate.
for mode,name in [('L','gray2.jpg'),('CMYK','cmyk2.jpg')]:
    img=Image.new(mode,(31,31),0)
    img.save('/workspace/'+name,format='JPEG',quality=90)
    b=bytearray(Path('/workspace/'+name).read_bytes())
    idx=b.find(b'\xff\xc0')
    print(name, idx, list(b[idx:idx+20]))
    if idx!=-1 and mode=='CMYK':
        for i,v in enumerate([0x44,0x44,0x44,0x44]):
            b[idx+10+i*3]=v
        Path('/workspace/'+name.replace('.jpg','.bin')).write_bytes(b)
        print('patched', list(b[idx:idx+20]))
PY
